message.content:
{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "Selected pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT. Baseline build job completed successfully with observed job runtimes of 7-11 seconds and workflow elapsed up to 17 seconds, while required checks passed. Added an explicit job timeout of 5 minutes to the build job, providing headroom over baseline successful durations and a bounded runaway-consumption limit. No install, test, trigger, or check semantics were changed.",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: PHP Composer

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Validate composer.json and composer.lock
      run: composer validate --strict

    - name: Cache Composer packages
      id: composer-cache
      uses: actions/cache@v3
      with:
        path: vendor
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-php-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-php-

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

    - name: Run linter
      run: composer run-script lint

    - name: Run tests
      run: composer run-script tests"
}
